headline: With ‘Girls Like Girls,’ Hayley Kiyoko Turns Her Teenage Pain Into Art
context: The once-closeted star has reinvented her song “Girls Like Girls” as a best-selling Y.A. novel and a new theatrical film. It wasn’t easy.
